text:
1962 FIFA World Cup no kɔɔ Chile wɔ 30 May kɔsi 17 June, ɛyɛ ɛberɛ a South America ɔman no dii agorɔ no kɛkɛ. Teams 16 na ɛkoe, wɔkyekyee wɔn mu kɔɔ groups anan a group biara wɔ teams anan; group biara mu top two kɔɔ single-elimination knockout stage a ɛwɔ quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place match ne final. Ɛyɛ Wiase Kup a edi kan a wɔde goal average dii dwuma sɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ points pɛ a wɔn ntam nni, tiebreaker a ɛboaa wɔn sɛ wɔnkyekyere group standings. Agorɔ no yɛ defensive kɛse: goals a wɔtow no average kɔɔ 2.78 per match, ɛtoaa ase sɛ ɛredɔ, na total attendance kɔɔ 893,172 wɔ competition no mu, average bɛyɛ 27,912 per match.

Brazil, reigning champions a wofi 1958, bae sɛ favourites nanso wɔhweree wɔn reigning star ntɛm bere a Pelé hyɛɛ group stage mu na ɔhyɛɛ no, ɔanka bio. Amarildo bɛhyɛɛ n’ananmu. Garrincha bɛyɛɛ Brazil adeɛ a ɛde wɔn kɔɔ anim, ɔkyerɛɛ tournament no top-scorer total a ɛyɛ goals anan. Wɔhwɛ no sɛ ɔyɛ agorɔfoɔ a ɛsen biara wɔ competition no mu, ɔsoaa ɔman no bere a Pelé hyɛɛ no, nanso Golden Ball a ɛdi tumi nni wɔ 1962. Top-scorer a ɛyɛ goals anan no, players nsia na ɛkyerɛɛ: Garrincha ne Vavá a wofi Brazil, Leonel Sánchez a ɔfiri Chile, Flórián Albert a ɔfiri Hungary, Valentin Ivanov a ɔfiri Soviet Union ne Dražan Jerković a ɔfiri Yugoslavia.

Final no kɔɔ 17 June wɔ Estadio Nacional a ɛwɔ Santiago anim spectators 68,679, Brazil ne Czechoslovakia hyiae. Masopust buee scoring no maa Czechoslovakia, nanso Brazil de Amarildo, Zito ne Vavá bɛtwaa so kɔɔ 3–1 na wɔgyee title a ɛto so mmienu. Ɛno nti Brazil bɛyɛɛ ɔman a ɛto so mmienu a ɛsan dii Wiase Kup, Italy akyi wɔ 1934 ne 1938. Czechoslovakia gyinaa second. Hosts Chile gyee third by beating Yugoslavia 1–0, Yugoslavia gyinaa fourth. Agorɔ no mu nsɛm a ɛda so ara mu biako ne 'Battle of Santiago', Chile ne Italy ntam group-stage match a ɛyɛ basabasa, hosts no dii nkunim 2–0.
